memory.statement: Founded an independent AI & Tech advisory practice focused on enterprise process automation and multi-agent system deployment.
Architected multi-agent AI pipelines (n8n, ComfyUI, LLM agents) for automated document processing, intelligent support workflows, and content automation.
Designed, built, and launched eterapy.com - an end-to-end AI-driven SaaS platform featuring web, mobile, Telegram Mini App, and automated payment gateways using cutting-edge AI engineering tools.
Pausing active client work to pursue a senior leadership role (VP of Tech / COO) where AI and automation capabilities can be applied at organizational scale.

Brought in to execute a strategic turnaround of two technology divisions managing 250+ professionals and a broad portfolio of IT products, cloud solutions, and managed services for heavy industry holdings.
Rebuilt leadership, organizational structure, and ITIL 4-based processes (Incident, Problem, Release, Knowledge, Availability, Service Catalog) across both divisions.
Grew combined revenue 4x and improved operating margin from near-zero to ~40% by consolidating fragmented service contracts into unified long-term agreements.
Achieved 99.5–100% SLA compliance across all commercial enterprise services (previously chronic underperformance).
Built DevOps function from scratch; deployed unified monitoring across all infrastructure services (Zabbix).
Led technical operations and support for a premier public cloud platform (IaaS/PaaS/DBaaS) serving thousands of enterprise B2B customers.
Drove CSAT from 23% to 68%, SLA compliance from 50% to 92%, and FCR from 5% to 83% — while reducing inbound ticket volume by 40% through self-service portal and AI-powered search.
Built proprietary cloud tooling from scratch: statuspage, self-service knowledge base, and automated bot-based support workflows integrated into the platform.
Modernized the full support stack - migrating to Atlassian Jira Service Management and unifying L1/L2 support, partner integrations, and product development in a single instance.
Developed a paid managed services go-to-market (GTM) strategy with full pricing model - approved by executive C-suite leadership.
Scaled business from $73K seed investment to $50M+ annual revenue - company successfully exited via acquisition.
Owned full C-suite operational scope: Human Resources & Talent Acquisition, Legal & Compliance, Supply Chain & Procurement, Inventory Management, Facilities, and Fleet & Marine Operations.
Oversaw land acquisition, construction, and launch of 14 offshore production facilities and a headquarters building.

Built entire technology infrastructure from scratch: ERP (Microsoft Dynamics AX), IoT environmental monitoring systems, transport tracking, distributed data infrastructure, and cross-site network connectivity including radio relay towers.
Led multinational team across 10+ nationalities including Malaysia, Australia, China, India, and US.

Joined as the sole IT specialist and built the entire IT function from scratch for one of the world's top-ranked corporate universities - a 37,000 m² campus serving up to 600 simultaneous learners across 38 state-of-the-art classrooms, supporting training for 250,000+ employees.
Built IT infrastructure from zero: domain environment, VoIP telephony, server virtualization, ERP systems, end-user devices, and full network infrastructure.
Led technical commissioning and launch of the new campus - coordinating contractors and managing full organizational relocation.
Managed multimedia and AV infrastructure across 38 classrooms - supporting high-profile international events attended by ministers and heads of state.
Grew and led a team of 9 IT engineers; managed IT budget growing from ~$650K to ~$4M as the organization scaled.

Delivered premium IT support to C-suite executives, board members, and international investors across 45 global office locations - maintaining 100% on-time resolution across ~200 weekly requests with zero escalations.
Reduced incident resolution time by 40% through structured coordination of L1, L2, and application support teams (20+ engineers).
Promoted from IT Support Specialist to Premium Support Lead within two years.
Я смог собрать сервисы Россети Цифра в несколько пакетов: фронтовые сервисы, инфраструктурные ИТ-сервисы и продукты, созданные на базе Россети Цифра.

Примерно 30 человек прошли через меня с моим утверждением; остальные решения принимали мои подчинённые либо команды переходили целыми группами из других подразделений.
Для новых сервисов использовались существующие команды без найма новых сотрудников.
Когда я только пришел в Россети Цифра, выручка направления составляла порядка 230 миллионов рублей в год.
Мы наняли дополнительных продуктовых менеджеров и поменяли роль человека на роль CPO для ускорения обсуждения технических заданий, продуктов и контрактования с заказчиками.
Для контроля качества отслеживались SLA, доступность, РТО, РПО, отсутствие жалоб и своевременное выполнение тикетов.
В начале команда, скорее всего, составляла около 160 человек, а затем стала около 250 человек.
Три пакета суммарно давали порядка двух миллиардов рублей выручки в год.
Мы внедряли IoT и ERP.
Цифра 80% по time-to-market была выдумана, и я не могу её обосновать.
SLA составлял 99,5–100% в соответствии с контрактом; были некоторые несущественные просадки.
Должность правильная: директор по поддержке программных решений технологических систем.
Я не знаю LongGraph и LongChain.
